% Report-specific packages and macros. Loaded before hyperref (the CVPR kit's convention).
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{positioning,arrows.meta,fit,calc}
\usepackage{multirow}
\usepackage{microtype}

% --- Results wiring ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Every results table and figure is generated by `cs2wm report-assets` (#36) into tables/ and
% figures/. If a file is missing, a clearly marked placeholder is typeset instead, so
% `latexmk -pdf main.tex` works at any stage.
%
% Contract with #36:
%   tables/<name>.tex   a booktabs `tabular` only (no table float, caption or label: the report adds them)
%   figures/<name>.pdf  a vector figure (the report adds the caption)

\newcommand{\placeholderbox}[3]{% #1 = file, #2 = issue that fills it, #3 = what it shows
  \fbox{\parbox{0.92\linewidth}{\centering\small
    \textbf{TBD}: \texttt{\detokenize{#1}} not generated yet (#2).\\ #3}}}

% \resulttable{name}{issue}{description}
\newcommand{\resulttable}[3]{%
  \IfFileExists{tables/#1.tex}{\input{tables/#1.tex}}{\placeholderbox{tables/#1.tex}{#2}{#3}}}

% \resultfigure{name}{width}{issue}{description}
\newcommand{\resultfigure}[4]{%
  \IfFileExists{figures/#1.pdf}{\includegraphics[width=#2]{figures/#1.pdf}}%
  {\placeholderbox{figures/#1.pdf}{#3}{#4}}}
